transcript.text: indesit oven stoped heating, fan goes round n light on but its stone cold after 20 mins. grill werks fine tho. any ideas b4 i call some1 out

Since the fan is running but there is no heat in the main oven while the grill works fine, the most likely cause is that the ring-shaped heating element at the back of the oven has failed. The grill uses a different element and circuit, which explains why it still works. Before calling an engineer, please check if you can see any obvious damage to that rear ring element (cracks or blackened patches). If it looks intact but there is still no heat after 20 minutes on the fan setting, it will likely need replacing by a qualified person as it involves working with mains electricity.
ok isolated it at the cooker switch on the wall n took the back panel off (4 screws). theres a blister/split in the coil near the bottom with a black mark on it. so is that the element gone?

Yes, that blister and split suggests the fan oven element has failed internally; it can no longer heat up properly. To ensure you get the correct part for your Indesit cooker, please check the rating plate (usually on the frame around the oven door opening) and provide the full model number.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
its an Indesit IFW 6330 IX, off the rating plate on the door frame

[Heading: Likely cause: fan oven element]
You will need to replace this part with one that matches your Indesit IFW 6330 IX model. Please check the listing carefully against your model number before ordering. If you are not comfortable working with mains electricity or dismantling the appliance further, please call a qualified engineer.
[Likely component involved]
[Part card: 1800w Fan Element — £30.00 — Confirmed fit for your model — link "View at Spares4Repairs"]

candidates: Selector switch or wiring fault to the fan element (medium)
Control/PCB not sending power to the heating circuit (low)
